settings.discord.title: Discord (bot mode)
settings.discord.noteWebhook: Overrides for the Discord status card - an empty field means the environment value applies. URL and interval are picked up automatically at the next card update, so within one old interval and without any restart. A changed URL posts a fresh card in the new channel; delete the old message manually.
settings.discord.disabled: The Discord status card is disabled - set DISCORD_STATUS_ENABLED=true (plus a webhook URL or a bot token and channel id) in your default.env and restart the companion container. Below you see what is currently configured for both modes.
settings.discord.botInactive: The bot is off duty - no valid bot setup is configured, so nothing here is editable. To use bot mode, set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and DISCORD_STATUS_CHANNEL_ID in default.env and restart the companion. The values below show what default.env currently holds for this mode.
settings.discord.webhookInactive: These webhook settings are taking a nap - a bot token is set, so the card runs in bot mode and ignores them. To switch back, remove DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN from default.env and restart the companion. The values below show what default.env currently holds for this mode.
settings.discord.gameserverWebhookOn: Heads-up: the gameserver also posts its own webhook messages (start/stop/updates, player joins/leaves) - WEBHOOK_ENABLED=true in default.env. That runs inside the gameserver container and can only be changed there, not from this panel.
settings.discord.gameserverWebhookOff: The gameserver's own webhook messages are switched off (WEBHOOK_ENABLED=false in default.env) - every Discord message here comes from the companion.
settings.discord.note: Overrides for the Discord bot - an empty field means the environment value applies. Channels, presence and interval are picked up automatically at the next card update, so within one old interval and without any restart; only the slash-command toggle needs a companion restart. Careful: everyone who can use the moderation commands in the admin channel can control the gameserver (manage that via channel visibility and Server Settings → Integrations).
settings.discord.presence: Show bot presence (online member with player count)
settings.discord.saved: Discord settings saved - live within one update interval, no restart needed (only the slash-command toggle needs one)
settings.discord.emojiNote: Replace any status-card or event emoji with your own - paste a Discord emoji token (<:name:id>; type the emoji with a leading backslash in Discord to get it). Empty fields keep the current source: /setup-icons upload, environment token or the shipped default (shown as placeholder). Applied at the next card update.
settings.restartPending: Saved changes are pending - a server restart is required to apply them
settings.manualMode: SERVER_SETTINGS_MODE=manual - edit the INI file directly, or switch to auto to use this editor
settings.precedenceNote: Precedence at server start: template default < environment variable (default.env) < panel override. Overrides are stored on the game volume and survive container restarts and re-creation.
settings.restartTriggered: Restart triggered - the server is saving and shutting down, the container restart policy will bring it back up
settings.restartFailed: Restart failed - the server REST API did not respond. Check the container logs and try again.
